contract.rule: The Global Experience Agent treats skills as small, predictable, owner-routed functional units with explicit invocation boundaries, completion criteria, and verification; upstream skills are learned from, not copied or granted authority.
terminal_goal_contribution: reduce accidental skill invocation by separating human-only orchestration from model-reachable discipline
reduce context load by keeping top-level skill descriptions trigger-focused and pushing branch-only reference behind context pointers
reduce premature completion by requiring checkable completion criteria for actionable steps
improve implementation quality by preferring red-capable feedback loops, pre-agreed seams, tracer-bullet work slices, and two-axis review

model_invoked.description_rule: front-load the leading word, encode one trigger branch per distinct condition, and avoid restating body content
model_invoked.context_load_rule: keep model-visible descriptions short because every visible trigger competes for attention each turn
model_invoked.split_rule: split only when an independent leading word or owner handoff must be reachable by the model

user_invoked.local_mapping: human-requested router-or-command path that is not automatically selected by a model
user_invoked.description_rule: human-facing summary only; it must not become an autonomous model trigger
user_invoked.cognitive_load_rule: use a router or decision guide when too many human-only entrypoints require memorization
user_invoked.structural_rule: a user-invoked workflow may route to model-invoked functional units, but must not silently invoke another human-only workflow

model_visible_surface.rule: Top-level model-visible SKILL descriptions stay trigger-focused and under the recommended length unless a separately recorded safety boundary requires more text.
model_visible_surface.fallback: Move branch-only detail into the owner body, an owner-internal subskill, or a directly linked reference.
model_visible_surface.imported_wrapper_rule: Codex Home imported compatibility wrappers use a short owner-routed description and must never advertise themselves as top-level entries; upstream SKILL.md files remain preserved reference material, not generated discovery surfaces.

agent_like_skill_economy.parent_skill_rule: A parent skill is a specialist Agent entry surface: it owns the trigger, authority boundary, handoffs, and exit criteria, while branch-only execution detail belongs in owner-internal subskills or references.
agent_like_skill_economy.subskill_rule: A subskill is an owner-internal functional unit: split it out when it has a distinct trigger, write surface, proof loop, or reusable procedure; merge it back when it only restates the parent or has no independent verification.
agent_like_skill_economy.merge_rule: Merge duplicate skills or subskills when they share trigger, maintained knowledge, artifacts, safety boundary, and verifier; keep one compatibility pointer for one release when discovery names changed.
agent_like_skill_economy.split_rule: Split a skill only when the split reduces model-visible ambiguity or isolates a different tool gate, artifact lifecycle, or safety boundary.
agent_like_skill_economy.upstream_rule: Upstream imported SKILL.md files remain reference material under wrappers; they do not define owner authority, model-visible triggers, or structural entrypoints.
agent_like_skill_economy.concept_agent_rule: Concept Agents compose existing parent skills and subskills; they never create parallel top-level skills or bypass owner gates.

steps.rule: inline only the ordered actions every run needs
steps.completion_criterion: each step that changes state or makes a claim must end at a checkable, preferably exhaustive condition

reference.rule: keep definitions, rules, and caveats co-located; move branch-only or shared reference behind a context pointer
reference.pointer_rule: the pointer wording controls whether the agent reliably loads the reference; sharpen wording before inlining large reference

pruning.rule: prefer one source of truth, remove sediment and no-op lines, and use positive target behavior plus hard guardrails only where needed
pruning.owner_economy: revise an existing owner or owner-internal subskill before adding a top-level owner

alignment.rule: lookup facts from files/tools first; ask the human only consequential decisions; ask one blocking decision at a time when live input is required

task_slicing.rule: large or foggy work becomes named decision tickets; implementation work becomes tracer-bullet vertical slices with blocking edges; wide refactors use expand-contract batches

implementation.rule: when tests are warranted, agree or infer the public seam, create a red-capable check before the fix or feature, implement one vertical slice, then run targeted checks regularly and full validation at closeout

debugging.rule: first build a tight red-capable loop for the user symptom; minimise before hypothesising; instrument one prediction at a time; close with regression proof or an explicit missing-seam finding

review.rule: review substantial diffs against two separate axes: repo standards and originating spec; do not let one axis mask the other

module_design.rule: prefer deep modules: small interface, large hidden behavior, clean seam, tests through the interface, and locality for future fixes

rejected_or_deferred.reason: the current Agent already has owner-routed skills, interface gates, and release validation; installing upstream skills would add overlapping triggers and external update drift
local collaboration rules only spawn subagents under explicit user or skill instruction; the adapted policy keeps the two-axis review concept without making parallel execution mandatory
GitHub/Linear/local tracker publication remains gated; local Agent decision tickets can be represented as lifecycle/workflow artifacts first

no_regression: human, llm, internal-functional-unit, and global-control interface permissions remain governed by config/agent-interface-policy.json
no user-invoked upstream workflow becomes an automatic model trigger
no upstream runtime, plugin, credential, or external tracker is installed
skill-invocation policy is registered as an information unit and verified as a functional unit
invalidation_conditions: mattpocock/skills materially changes its invocation taxonomy
local Agent interface policy changes caller authority semantics
a repeated local failure shows that router or model-invoked boundaries cause missed work or false invocation
